newsitem.title: USA: Aviva Petroleum seeks drilling funding.
newsitem.headline: Aviva Petroleum seeks drilling funding.

text.p: Aviva Petroleum Inc is seeking funding for drilling a deep exploratory well on its Breton Sound lease in Louisiana state waters of the Gulf of Mexico, spokesman Ron Suttill said Wednesday.
The lease adjoins, on the north, the block where Exxon Corp made its Breton Sound discovery, he noted.
Aviva said several prospective industry partners are reviewing the company's seismic data.

Based on that data and information about the Exxon well, recoverable reserves on Aviva's 60 percent owned block are estimated at 200 to 300 billion cubic feet of natural gas and 10 to 20 million barrels of oil.
The remaining working interest is held by individuals, Suttill said.
Aviva said Exxon is expected to begin production within the next two weeks from its discovery well, which is located about 3,000 feet from Aviva's lease line.
Suttill said Exxon will be producing reserves found below 16,000 feet, adding Aviva expects to find the same formation at shallower depths on its lease -- maybe below 14,000 feet.
